title: RIQE: a NIQE-style reference model for Computed Tomography
description:
RIQE (Radiology Image Quality Evaluator) is a NIQE-style no-reference image quality model fitted on full-dose computed tomography instead of natural photographs, released with its validation and with everything needed to rebuild it from public data.

The artefact carries the intensity mapping that defines the model (a fixed Hounsfield window, part of the specification), the hyperparameters and the criterion that selected them, the identity of every slice used with its SHA-256, and the identity of the code that produced it. A verification script refits from the same public data and compares.

On held-out patients RIQE ranks degraded images (simulated reduced dose, added noise, blur) worse than their source, but its preferences among filtered images do not follow the signal of small inserted lesions. It is suited to paired ranking and should not be the sole criterion for selecting, comparing or tuning denoisers. The score is a distance from the declared model, not a judgement of diagnostic quality, and is not comparable with NIQE values in the literature.

Fitted on the CC BY 4.0 Chest and Liver subsets of the TCIA collection LDCT-and-Projection-data (DOI 10.7937/9npb-2637, version 7). Algorithm implemented from Mittal, Soundararajan and Bovik, IEEE SPL 20(3):209-212, 2013; no third-party code incorporated. Code: MIT licence; model, manifests and results: CC BY 4.0.
